title: Shift Solenoid A Intermittent
shortDescription: Intermittent electrical fault in shift solenoid A circuit.
fullDescription: Intermittent electrical fault in shift solenoid A circuit. Diagnose with proper scan tool, verify codes, inspect related circuits per service manual.
safetyImpact: Transmission/driveline issue — drivability affected, may enter limp mode.

fixSteps.title: Scan for codes
fixSteps.instruction: Read all codes; note freeze frame data.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Check solenoid connector, harness for damage/corrosion.

fixSteps.title: Test solenoid resistance
fixSteps.instruction: Compare reading to spec; replace if out of range.

fixSteps.title: Replace solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Drop pan, replace solenoid, refill ATF to spec.

faq.a: Limited driving may be possible but transmission damage can occur. Have it diagnosed promptly.
